profile.description:
Qwen Image 3.0 supports image generation and editing with Base and Pro variants, multilingual typography, multi-image references, and controllable 1K or 2K output.

Generation & Editing
- Generate from a text prompt
- Edit or combine one to three attached images
- Generate one to six images per request

This bot supports optional parameters for additional customization.
